title: DID GOOGLE
*CHANGE YOUR*
ADS?
slides.sub: Five settings to check since Google's AI Max switch.

title: GOOGLE FLIPPED
*THE SWITCH*
FOR YOU
slides.body: On 1 September 2026, Google moved Search campaigns using broad match or auto-created assets onto AI Max. You didn't have to click a thing.

title: IS AI MAX
*SWITCHED ON?*
slides.body: Open each Search campaign's settings. If AI Max is on, Google now picks extra searches for your ad and writes some of your ad text.

title: READ YOUR
*SEARCH TERMS*
slides.body: AI Max shows your ad for searches you never chose. Check the search terms report every week. ("Plumbing apprentice jobs Joondalup" is not a customer.)

title: ADD
*NEGATIVE*
KEYWORDS
slides.body: Negative keywords still block searches under AI Max. Add "jobs" and "DIY" so you stop paying for people who will never book.

title: READ THE
*AD TEXT*
GOOGLE WROTE
slides.body: Google writes headlines from your website. Your site still says "same day service" from 2023? Your ad says it now too.

title: CHECK WHERE
*THE CLICK*
LANDS
slides.body: Google now picks which page people land on. Exclude your blog and careers pages. Buyers belong on the page with your phone number.

title: *RECAP*
items: Check if AI Max is on
Read the ad text Google wrote
Check which page clicks land on

title: WANT A
